ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a large triangle RST, with R at the lower left, S at the lower right, and T above. Point L is located on side RT, point W is located on side RS, and segment LW connects L and W. In the figure, LW and TS have arrow markings in the same direction, indicating LW ∥ TS. Reasoning: It is known that TR = 8, LR = 3, RW = 6. Because LW ∥ TS, the small triangle RLW and the large triangle RTS are similar. Corresponding sides are proportional: RL/RT = RW/RS. method.method_draft: First read the image as triangle RST with segment LW drawn from side RT to side RS, parallel to side TS. From the text, use TR = 8 and LR = 3 to find the remaining upper side segment LT = TR - LR = 5. Since LW ∥ TS, the side-splitter theorem gives proportional divisions on the two sides: LR/LT = RW/WS. Substitute 3/5 = 6/WS and solve to get WS = 10.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是三角形 RST，R 在左下，T 在上方，S 在右侧。点 L 位于边 RT 上，点 W 位于边 RS 上，并且线段 LW 从边 RT 连到边 RS。图中 LW 和 TS 上有相同方向的箭头标记，表示 LW ∥ TS。

推理：已知 TR = 8，LR = 3，所以边 RT 上剩余的线段 LT = TR - LR = 8 - 3 = 5。因为 LW ∥ TS，根据平行线分线段成比例定理，边 RT 和 RS 被按相同比例分割：LR/LT = RW/WS。代入 LR = 3，LT = 5，RW = 6，得到 3/5 = 6/WS。交叉相乘：3WS = 30，所以 WS = 10。
